name: Castellcir (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a light blue bordure of eight pieces and, at the centre, the light blue castle of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 24 July 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3695 of 8 August 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with a light blue bordure of eight pieces 1/18 of the height thick, those at the corners 1/4 of the height by 1/6 of the length, and the castle of the arms at the centre.

features.role: bordure of eight pieces, 1/18 of the height thick
